column1: # ngsdose sinks --stats: resources/GRCh38/sinks.bed evaluated on 1375 scan(s)
# Statistics of the bundle's sinks.bed (rDNA45S 19, rDNA5S 2, DJ 59 and TEL 63 intervals), for `ngsdose fetchplan --capture`.

# Scans: 1,375 whole-file scans of the 1000 Genomes 30x cohort (NYGC pipeline: bwa-mem 0.7.15, ALT-aware, GRCh38 analysis set with decoys and HLA; engine fae1124): the 1,748 counted by 2026-09-25 less the 372 of 2026-09-22 (NGS-DOSE-1000G fd39309) and HG02258.

# Held out: the positional classes' intervals were learned from NA12878 and HG02258 (bundle.json sinks_learned_from), TEL's from those 372 scans; NA12878 is not among the 1,748 counted scans (it is a cohort genome, not yet scanned: a re-evaluation on later scans must leave it out, and HG02258, too).
# Specific to that aligner and reference. Made with: ngsdose sinks SCANS --evaluate sinks.bed --held-out --stats sinks.stats.tsv (strict bins; fully unmapped reads count as missed).
# held-out: yes: none of these scans was used to learn the intervals
